strategy_title: Avoid Oversized Shared Memory Tiles That Crush Occupancy
strategy_description: Increasing BLOCK_M from 64→128 and BLOCK_K from 32→64 with num_stages=4 in tl.range caused dynamic shared memory per block to balloon from ~49 KB to ~197 KB, reducing Block Limit Shared Mem from 3 to 1 block/SM and theoretical occupancy from 18.75% to 6.25%. Despite register pressure dropping (168→32 registers/thread), the shared memory bottleneck became the sole occupancy limiter, and the warp stall cycles per instruction jumped from 3.26 to 18.51 due to L1TEX latency on uncoalesced local loads/stores (new MemoryCacheAccessPattern rule triggered). The net effect was a 25x slowdown: executed instructions grew 4.6x while occupancy did not improve, indicating the larger tiles created far more work without hiding latency.
slow_pseudocode:
# Before: BLOCK_M=64, BLOCK_K=32, ~49KB smem, 168 regs/thread
for k_idx in range(0, cdiv(K, BLOCK_K)):
    a = tl.load(A + ...)
    b = tl.load(B + ...)
    acc += tl.dot(a, b)
fast_pseudocode:
# After (REGRESSED): BLOCK_M=128, BLOCK_K=64, num_stages=4, ~197KB smem, 32 regs/thread
for k_idx in tl.range(0, cdiv(K, BLOCK_K), num_stages=4):
    a = tl.load(A + ...)
    b = tl.load(B + ...)
    acc += tl.dot(a, b)
# Result: smem limit = 1 block/SM, theoretical occupancy 6.25%, 25x slower
applicable_when: Never applicable as implemented — increasing tile sizes to reduce register pressure is counterproductive when the resulting shared memory allocation becomes the sole occupancy limiter (Block Limit Shared Mem = 1).
do_not_apply_when: Do not increase BLOCK_M or BLOCK_K when the resulting dynamic shared memory per block exceeds ~100KB on Hopper (sm_90), as this will reduce Block Limit Shared Mem to 1 block/SM and eliminate any occupancy benefit from reduced register pressure. Also avoid using tl.range with num_stages when the kernel already has uncoalesced local memory access patterns, as the pipelining overhead compounds the stall cycles.
framework_notes: In Triton on Hopper (sm_90), tl.range(..., num_stages=N) enables async pipeline prefetching but requires shared memory staging buffers proportional to BLOCK_M * BLOCK_K * num_stages * dtype_bytes. With BLOCK_M=128, BLOCK_K=64, num_stages=4, float32: 128*64*4*4 = 131KB for A alone, explaining the 197KB total. The Block Limit Shared Mem = 1 means only 1 block per SM, negating all other optimizations.
